chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Reminding others of a favor destroys the good deed."

key_terms.اَلصَّنِيعَةَ: the good deed, favor, or act of kindness done for someone
key_terms.اَلْمَنُّ: reminding someone of one's favor in a hurtful or self-glorifying way

ai.seo_question: How does reminding someone of a favor affect the reward of a good deed in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that boasting of one's favor or reminding someone of it nullifies its moral value. The hadith emphasizes sincerity, humility, and preserving the dignity of the one who received the good deed.
